messages:
oliver: Heads up — got a customer report and our monitoring spike at 09:11 UTC for inference-api (503). I see an alert in the metrics channel but no PagerDuty pages were delivered. @pagerbot any delivery failures?

pagerbot: delivery error summary: 2026-03-17T09:11:05Z -> PagerDuty API 500 x3 from notify-service. Last error: 'invalid signature header'. See /var/log/pagerbot/deliveries.log lines 345-358.

maya: huh. incident-bot should have auto-fallback to SMS/escalation policy. kevin are you oncall for svc-inference right now?

kevin: yep I'm oncall. I did not get paged or an SMS. I only saw a Slack ping in #incidents at ~09:11. Phone was silent. I'm switching to manual escalation now.

samira: doing manual PD trigger now so ops can get eyes. running: `pd trigger --service svc-inference --summary "inference api 503" --severity high`

kevin: copy — got the SMS now. thanks Samira. Can someone check the webhook signing header? we've had header key/name changes bite us before.

incident-bot: deploy metadata — notify-service v2.3.1 deployed at 2026-03-17T09:12:10Z by maya. Change summary: header serialization change (X-Pager-Signature -> X-Pager-Signature-Base64).

oliver: that lines up — pagerbot expects X-Pager-Signature. notify-service changed the header name and PagerDuty rejects the payload as unsigned. Need a compatibility shim in pagerbot or revert.

maya: I can ship a quick compatibility shim to accept either header key. Pushing canary now. Command: `/deploy pagerbot/shim-accept-signature-canary`

pagerbot: shim deployed to canary -> acceptance logic updated. Retrying queued deliveries. Current status: 12/12 retried, 12/12 delivered successfully.

kevin: confirmed deliveries are back. Still need to validate customer impact — CX reported errors for ~3 customers between 09:10-09:20 UTC.

samira: noted for incident summary. Drafting timeline + impact in postmortem doc. Also creating follow-up ticket to add header compatibility tests in CI and a staging e2e for paging.

oliver: add a runbook step: if pages stop firing, do manual pd trigger and escalate to oncall-broadcast. Also log the notifier version and correlate against recent deploys.

maya: post-incident task created: INF-482 — add schema tests + paging e2e, assign eng-oncall. Adding owners and due date.

kevin: Locking the coordination here — paging restored, customers notified by CX. Will include this in the retro. :white_check_mark:
